Name: Millnificent Milling Rules
Author: causticwashername
Description:
[size=1]By [s]popular demand[/s] one suggestion: [/size]

Do you like the aesthetic appeal of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16890]Molenfeuer's Millnificent[/url] but also hop on any crops-adding mod you encounter? Are you too lazy to use the provided example to fix the dilemma of choosing between optics and function? Well I am — but nobody shared their solution so I had to make one for myself.

Currently adds the milling rules of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia - Artisan Machines[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20884]Grains Overhull[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26443]Chicken Feed
[/url]to the smock mill.

I don't know what I'm doing but I tested it and it works in my game so feel free to use it too. (づ ᴗ _ᴗ)づ♡
And big Thank You to the creative minds that created the mods that actually add things to the game. You're great!

Have a nice day!♥

[size=1]And don't hit me if I did something wrong. v-v [/size]

Manifest.Name: Millnificent Milling Rules
Manifest.Description: Adds the Milling Rules from Cornucopia & Grains Overhull to Molenfeuer's Windmills.
Manifest.Author: caustic
